questions: Does each bucket correspond to exactly one well, and can it only be used on that well, or can a bucket be used across different wells?
Is the bucket lowered once per well per trip, or can a single lowering handle multiple wells simultaneously?
When a bucket is lowered, does it extract water from only the well it's in at that moment, or can it extract from multiple wells in one lowering?
Are buckets refilled or reset after each lowering, or does partial capacity carry over between lowerings within the same well?
Is the goal to minimize the number of bucket-lowering operations, or is there a fixed procedure (like always fill bucket to capacity when possible)?
Does each '1' in the grid represent exactly one unit of water, and is water indivisible (i.e., can a bucket extract part of a unit)?
Can the bucket capacity be larger than the total water in a well, and if so, does lowering it still count as an operation even if it extracts nothing?
Is the grid guaranteed to contain only 0s and 1s, and are there any missing values or non-integer entries?
